_README: Copy this file to runner.config.json and fill it in (see README.md). Generate each signing secret and API secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`. runner.config.json holds real secrets — chmod 600 it and NEVER commit it. server.mjs loads it from $RUNNER_CONFIG (the systemd unit sets /etc/chapter-craft-runner/runner.config.json) or ./runner.config.json.
_doc_keys: REQUIRED. Map of keyId -> signing secret. The app signs each request with HMAC-SHA256; the keyId it sends must exist here and the secret must match. Unknown or empty keys are rejected (no empty-secret fallback). You paste one keyId + its secret into the app's Program Foundry settings.
_doc_secrets: OPTIONAL. Map of SECRET_NAME -> value. A program declares which names it needs (manifest.secrets); the runner injects only those, by name, as env vars into that job's container, then REDACTS the values out of stdout/stderr. The app and the model never see these values — only the names.
_doc_sandbox_image: OPTIONAL (default chapter-craft-sandbox:latest). The docker image built from Dockerfile.sandbox.
_doc_egress_network: OPTIONAL (default ccprog-egress). The docker network created by setup-egress.sh for allowlist-egress jobs. Ignored entirely unless a program requests network 'allowlist' AND the startup self-test passed.
_doc_egress_proxy_ip: OPTIONAL (default 172.31.99.2). The ccprog-proxy container's fixed IP — must match setup-egress.sh's CCPROG_PROXY_IP. Injected into sandboxes as a static /etc/hosts entry for 'ccprog-proxy' because Docker's embedded DNS does not work under gVisor.
_doc_allowed_hosts_global: OPTIONAL (default []). The hostnames the egress proxy will dial for allowlist jobs. Empty array = deny all outbound (every job effectively runs offline even in allowlist mode). '*.example.com' matches the apex and any subdomain.
_doc_max_timeout_ms: OPTIONAL (default 60000). Hard ceiling on a job's wall-clock time; a program's own manifest.timeout_ms is clamped to this.
_doc_concurrency: OPTIONAL (default 3). Max jobs running at once.
_doc_queue_max: OPTIONAL (default 10). Max jobs waiting for a slot before new requests get 429.
_doc_port: OPTIONAL (default 8752). server.mjs binds 127.0.0.1 on this port only; put Caddy/TLS in front (see README).
_doc_memory: OPTIONAL (default 512m). Per-container memory limit; swap is pinned equal so there is no swap.
